registered: before computing any of the stressed books below
why: the best v9.9 candidate (ALL + add + HODLer, Bybit filter, 4.5% low-cap cap: 3.550 [2.686, 4.170, 3.360] vs v9.8 capped 3.061 [2.465, 3.870, 2.592]) rests on four event sleeves with few events, partly from one 2025 'young coins dumped' regime. Before it goes to paper it must show that the gain is not a handful of trades or luck, and that it survives live frictions
base: exactly R45 Bybit-filtered, capped (4.5% total low-cap, risk 1.5); the four new sleeves are stressed together, v9.8 sleeves untouched

stresses.S1 drop winners: remove the best 5% and the best 10% of events (by stand-alone trade return) in EACH new sleeve
stresses.S2 event bootstrap: resample the events of each new sleeve with replacement (200 draws, seed 48); report the distribution of capped book minus v9.8 capped
stresses.S3 entry delay: every new-sleeve entry 1 h, 3 h and 6 h later (live detection / announcement latency)
stresses.S4 costs: 2x and 3x the 10 bp per side on the new sleeves

judge: robust if ALL of: S1 drop-10% book >= 3.061 + 0.05 with no period lower than v9.8 capped; S2 P(gain <= 0) < 5%; S3 +3 h book >= 3.111; S4 2x costs book >= 3.111. Otherwise the candidate's planning Sharpe gets an extra discount equal to the shortfall (reported, not optimised)
